name: Headline wall
what: A wall of your headlines piles up behind your head: cards in white, dark, paper and mustard, each a bold headline with a small line (your name, the views), dropped onto the wall one after another. Then a big total pops in front of you under the chin and counts up, with a label beside it. The Editor puts the cards behind the person and the total in front.
origin: MotionLab's own build after a design in Vibha Ramprakash's claude-video-effects (MIT), 2026-10-28
motion: from f1 a card drops onto the wall every 3 frames (closer with more than 9: all within 24 f), each from 55 % and 24 px higher, turning 7 degrees into its own slight tilt (7 f, a small overshoot, fading in over 2 f); the cards sit above the shoulders round the head and drift 2 px out of step while they hold; 8 f after the last card (f30 with 8 headlines) the total pill pops in front under the chin (from 60 %, rising 30 px, 9 f, a small overshoot, tilted -3 degrees) and its number counts up over 20 f (slow end); a light crosses the pill (14 f, S-curve) and it breathes; the last 10 f the cards lift away and the pill sinks, fading (accelerating).
